name: Lyx
source: An adult Goblin and the greatest scientist of this or any age! No, seriously, I am! I mean she is. Lyx didn't break in and write this bio, you're just paranoid. I have a potion for that. I mean Lyx does. Shit! Listen, you didn't see anything, alright? I was never here. Smoke bomb!
